page.overview:
Who is Major Bludd?

Major Bludd is the first Cobra, and the first character, who dies in G.I. Joe Resolute. Likely, when he was alive had a similar function and personality as his ARAH counterpart.

Major Bludd is the first character appearing... dead. Scarlett, disguised as a CSI, confirms his identity via fingerprint scan at the scene of his gruesome murder scene in front of the Lincoln Memorial. We later learn he was killed by Cobra Commander because the Commander claimed Bludd tried to betray him.
